Voreingenommenheit.et: voreingenommen + -heit. Compare Dutch vooringenomenheid, Danish forudindtagethed.

s: for now, for the time being
pertaining to (the time of) a proto-language before its division into individual languages
voreinzelsprachlich.et: From vor- (“pre-”) + einzelsprachlich (“of [the time of] individual languages”).

vorenthalten.et: From Middle High German vorenthalten, equivalent to vor- + enthalten.

s: forefathers, foreparents (including both mothers and fathers)
1912, Martin Luther, Lutherbibel von 1912, 2 Timothy 1:3 (with KJV translation)
I thank God, whom I serve from my forefathers with pure conscience, that without ceasing I have remembrance of thee in my prayers night and day;
to take their hats off to each other
in front of one another / each other
to undress in front of each other
to keep secrets from each other

Voreinstellung.et: From voreinstellen + -ung, further from vor- + einstellen + -ung.
